contexts.text: To make cakes to the queen of the heavens () = to worship the devil from the good of celestial love... for the queen of the heavens = those who are in the Hell of the Genii.
The queen of the heavens () = falsities in the whole complex.
The queen of the heavens () = all evils in the complex; for the queen of the heavens has a like signification to that of the army of the heavens. (Compare AC 4581:8.)
